title: Brand Logo Usage Rule
description: Machine-readable logo selection and placement rule. Complements logos[].usage by making enforceable minimum size, clear-space, background, and context constraints queryable.

logo_url.description: Specific logo asset URL this rule applies to. Omit when the rule applies by variant or tags.

logo_id.description: Stable `logos[].id` this rule applies to. Prefer this over logo_url when the rule targets a specific logo entry.

logo_variant.description: Logo variant this rule applies to.

logo_tags.description: Logo tags this rule applies to.

contexts.description: Creative contexts where this rule applies.

slots.description: Canonical renderer slots where this rule applies. Use this for deterministic logo-card, profile-mark, end-card, and lockup selection.

minimum_size.title: Logo Minimum Size
minimum_size.description: Minimum rendered size needed for legibility.

clear_space.description: Minimum clear space around the logo, expressed in brand terms or units.

allowed_backgrounds.description: Background color roles, values, or surfaces where this logo may be placed.

forbidden_backgrounds.description: Background color roles, values, or surfaces where this logo must not be placed.

forbidden_contexts.description: Contexts where this logo must not be used, such as photography_without_knockout.

description.description: Human-readable rationale or source-language summary for the rule.
